name: Create, play, refresh, and resume the same Hunt
description: Verifies the critical play loop survives a real browser refresh without losing player identity, Essence, or authoritative Hunt state.
steps: Enter adventurer name Rook and create a Hunt
Confirm Resolve 20/20 and Crow Essence 4/4 are present
Choose Attack and note the six-character session code
Refresh the page
Choose another legal action
expected: The same Hunt code, player identity, current turn, HP, Crow Essence, score, and chronicle resume automatically without joining as a duplicate.

name: Invoke spends real Crow Essence and Defend restores it
description: Verifies the blue resource is authoritative game state rather than decorative HUD.
steps: Create a Hunt as Rook and confirm Essence 4/4
Use Invoke on a legal turn
Confirm Essence becomes 2/4 and the chronicle records the deterministic crowfire result
Use Invoke again on a legal turn so Essence reaches 0/4
Attempt Invoke at 0/4
Use Defend
expected: Each accepted Invoke spends exactly 2 Essence, insufficient Essence blocks Invoke without mutation, and Defend restores exactly 1 Essence up to the maximum while retaining its Resolve/guard behavior.

name: Second adventurer joins and receives realtime campaign updates
description: Verifies two browsers share one canonical Hunt and accepted turns propagate without refresh.
setup: Actor A creates a Hunt as Rook and keeps the six-character session code
steps: Actor B joins as Ash using Actor A's session code
Confirm both clients show the green realtime session indicator
Actor A performs the currently legal action while Actor B does not refresh
expected: Actor B automatically sees the updated turn, HP, Crow Essence, objective state, score, and Shared Chronicle entry.

name: Complete Chapter I and descend to the Bone Rookery
description: Verifies Chapter I transitions only after its real objective and enemy are resolved.
steps: Create a Hunt as Vale
Choose Awaken Altar and confirm Ember Feather appears
Use Attack, Invoke, and Defend strategically until the Crowbound Warden reaches 0 HP
expected: Chapter 2 The Bone Rookery becomes visible, the enemy changes to Bone Rook, the relic remains stored, and living party members begin the new chapter fully restored in Resolve and Crow Essence.

name: Finish the full campaign and return to the gate
description: Verifies the campaign has a real deterministic finish and a functioning exit path.
steps: Complete Chapter I
In Chapter II complete the rite then defeat the Bone Rook using legal Attack, Invoke and Defend turns
In Chapter III break the crown then defeat the Black Rook
Choose Return to Gate
expected: The victory banner appears with final score and three relics, no further turns mutate the finished Hunt, and Return to Gate clears only local Hunt identity.

name: Party defeat ends the Hunt on mobile
description: Verifies defeat remains a real terminal state and the player can leave cleanly.
steps: Create a Hunt as Ash on mobile
Use Speak repeatedly on legal turns so the enemy retaliates while taking no attack damage
Continue until the adventurer reaches 0 HP
Choose Return to Gate
expected: A defeat banner appears, the adventurer is marked FALLEN, all turn actions are disabled, and Return to Gate clears local identity and returns to the create/join screen.
